title: PvP Timer
description: This project creates a PvP timer that switches on for about 20 mins after it being disabled for abt 5-30 mins
body:
Its a plugin that switched PvP on and off:
On for 20 mins every 5-30 mins.
It is of for a random amount of time in the rage 5-30.
NOTE: if the tickspeed is changed then the time will not work properly. 
e.g. if tick speed is sped up then the range of time will be shorter like 2-25 mins etc
